title.narrative: Confidence building and conflict prevention through the promotion of mother tongue based multilingual education (MTB MLE) in Abkhazia ¿ Phase 2

description.narrative: Against the background of the predecessor project on Mother-Tongue-based Multi-lingual Education, this second phase will focus on Exposing key policy and decision makers, as well as education experts and specialists to international experiences and best practices to support the development of a specific MTB MLE model for Abkhazia Motivating constructive debate on MTB MLE across the dividing line Extending MTB MLE to the pre-school level, to ensure broader inclusion
